en-US.title: Lee Jae-mo Pizza Cheese Controversy? An Honest Taste Review
en-US.description:
A new Lee Jae-mo Pizza shop opened recently, so I tried buying some.

The taste is definitely good, but I don't think I would wait in line to eat there again.

It just feels like a handmade pizza place.

The cheese crust is definitely good, and the tomato sauce feels like it was made from fresh tomatoes rather than a store-bought one, so it's decent.

I should have tried it when they used Imsil cheese.

It's a shame.

#LeeJaeMoPizza #PizzaGourmet #BusanPizza

id.title: Kontroversi Keju Pizza Lee Jae-mo? Ulasan Rasa yang Jujur
id.description:
Sebuah gerai Lee Jae-mo Pizza baru baru saja dibuka, jadi saya mencoba membelinya.

Rasanya memang enak, tapi saya rasa saya tidak akan mengantre untuk makan di sana lagi.

Rasanya seperti tempat pizza buatan tangan.

Kerak kejunya memang enak, dan saus tomatnya terasa seperti dibuat dari tomat segar, bukan tomat kemasan, jadi lumayan.

Seharusnya saya mencobanya saat mereka masih menggunakan keju Imsil.
